Around the time I turned 25 I gained a new title

***Menace to Society.***

Since it was only used among friends I didn't take literally.

However, I was becoming a person that is not merely troublesome but potentially harmful to the society.

---

Popular musical groups are using names like 방탄소년, yet their ages are between 29 and 31. Similarly another popular group, Black Pink members are similarly aged.

This is a troubling trend.

Each generation needs a larger than life heroes, whether they be fictional or real.

---

Performers are delaying their lives in order to fulfill some wishes for the masses.
